conservative.requirements: 4 power. Engaged with target. Target must have just hit you with a Melee attack. Effect: When you are hit by a Melee attack, you may spend 4 power and place 6 recharge tokens on this card to cast this spell, targeting the enemy who has just struck you. You are surrounded by a nimbus of dancing flames; you burn your enemy for {Dc} number of wounds equal to your character's Strength attribute.
